newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two policemen killed by gunmen in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Two policemen killed by gunmen in Moscow.

text.p: Two policemen were killed and one was wounded on Thursday by gunmen apparently trying to hold up a commercial firm in the centre of Moscow.
A spokesman for Moscow police told Reuters men from its rapid reaction force went to the office of an Indian-owned company after an alarm went off.
When they tried to open the door, they were met with a hail of bullets which killed two policemen on the spot and wounded another.
One criminal and a woman passer-by were wounded in the ensuing shootout. The spokesman said three other criminals fled in a car and one more ran away. No one was immediately detained.
